cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(nano_ckzg_dependency LANGUAGES C ASM)
# Upstream source revisions and individual file hashes are in UPSTREAM.json.
add_library(nano_blst STATIC blst/src/server.c blst/build/assembly.S)
target_compile_definitions(nano_blst PRIVATE __BLST_PORTABLE__)
target_compile_options(nano_blst PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-O2;-fno-builtin>)
set_target_properties(nano_blst PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_library(nano_ckzg STATIC src/ckzg.c)
target_compile_options(nano_ckzg PRIVATE -O2)
set_target_properties(nano_ckzg PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(nano_ckzg PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/blst/bindings" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(nano_ckzg PUBLIC nano_blst)
# Embed the upstream public ceremony setup; runtime has no mutable setup path.
set(SETUP_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/trusted_setup.txt")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${SETUP_FILE}")
file(SHA256 "${SETUP_FILE}" SETUP_HASH)
if(NOT SETUP_HASH STREQUAL "d39b9f2d047cc9dca2de58f264b6a09448ccd34db967881a6713eacacf0f26b7")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned Ethereum KZG setup checksum mismatch")
endif()
file(STRINGS "${SETUP_FILE}" SETUP_LINES)
list(POP_FRONT SETUP_LINES G1_COUNT G2_COUNT)
list(LENGTH SETUP_LINES POINT_COUNT)
if(NOT G1_COUNT EQUAL 4096 OR NOT G2_COUNT EQUAL 65 OR NOT POINT_COUNT EQUAL 8257)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected pinned KZG setup dimensions")
endif()
list(SUBLIST SETUP_LINES 0 4096 G1_LAGRANGE)
list(SUBLIST SETUP_LINES 4096 65 G2_MONOMIAL)
list(SUBLIST SETUP_LINES 4161 4096 G1_MONOMIAL)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
set(SETUP_HEADER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/nano_kzg_setup.hpp")
file(WRITE "${SETUP_HEADER}" "// Generated from the checksum-verified upstream public setup.\n#pragma once\n")
foreach(GROUP G1_LAGRANGE G2_MONOMIAL G1_MONOMIAL)
 string(JOIN "" HEX_DATA ${${GROUP}})
 string(REGEX REPLACE "(..)" "0x\\1," BYTE_DATA "${HEX_DATA}")
 file(APPEND "${SETUP_HEADER}" "static const unsigned char ${GROUP}[] = {${BYTE_DATA}};\n")
endforeach()
